# Syed Ahmer Shah: tribute and support page

> Unofficial community tribute to Syed Ahmer Shah ("Ahmer"), a software engineer and full-stack developer from Hyderabad, Sindh, Pakistan. Summarises his education, projects, experience and public profiles. Data snapshot: 22/10/2026 (2026-10-22); details may have changed since. The official source is https://ahmershah.dev.

Key facts (as of 2026-10-22):
- Name: Syed Ahmer Shah (also "Ahmer Shah")
- Role: Software Engineer and Full-Stack Developer, studying Software Engineering
- Location: Hyderabad, Sindh, Pakistan (remote-first, Asia/Karachi, UTC+5)
- Education in progress: B.S. Software Engineering at HITMS (Nov 2024 to Dec 2028) and Advanced Diploma in Software Engineering at Aptech Pakistan (Aug 2025 to Sep 2028)
- Notable projects (2026): HolidayOps, GleanGrid, Zovita+, BookMyMovie, Commerza
- Experience: Full Stack Developer intern at XCL Technologies, 15 Jul to 15 Aug 2026
- "Top Software Engineer" in this page's title is the tribute's headline, not an official ranking.
